operator_progress.summary: Commit 828ceade96bf3897172f670ce4f8622b39ae67b6 completed the ambiguity-metadata hardening, and all 124 immutable tests plus 71 autonomous regressions pass. A remaining fail-closed gap exists in contact-field metadata validation. The classifier converts question and label values using str(value or ''), allowing falsey nonstring metadata such as None, False, 0, [], and {} to disappear. A recognized Email label can therefore produce verified_candidate despite an explicitly malformed question, while a whitespace-only label can be treated as absent. Preserve completed safeguards and reject malformed metadata before candidate classification.: Explicit nonstring question or label metadata and nonempty whitespace-only labels must produce human_review with reason invalid_field_metadata. Missing question or label keys, empty-string labels, and valid string metadata retain existing behavior. Preserve completed ambiguity and contact-type protections, verified-fact requirements, unknown-question handling, and read-only candidate mapping. Append regression coverage without replacing existing tests. Change only the two approved files, preserve the immutable Git blob identity, and independently pass all ten mandatory test cases before commit. No network, private data, submissions, deployment, publication, or automatic merge.
